_doc: The name a public file's card shows for its address, which both apps must agree on (2026-10-17): the desktop's src/gui/pages/chat/public_files.rs `shown_name` (its test a_file_is_shown_by_the_name_it_was_sent_with) and the website's web/chat/app.js `fileCardName` (scripts/tests/private-files-web.test.js). The last path part without a query or a fragment, the server's `<ms>_` time prefix taken off unless the name would then start with a dot, and %XX read as what it spells when that is text.
